title: Technical Support Engineer - Level 3 (VMWare)
description:
About the Company

Park Place Technologies is a global data center and networking optimization firm. Powered by the world’s largest on-the-ground engineering team, a robust group of advanced engineers and our fully staffed, 24x7x365 Enterprise Operations Center, we offer a robust portfolio of IT solutions to optimize networking and data center Uptime and performance. As the industry leader, our 2500 Park Place Associates provide support to 21,000+ customers in more than 180+ countries. We are proud to service 90% of Fortune 500 companies and 40% of Forbes 100 clients. Our company’s strength and success are a credit to our Associates, and Park Place Life is how we communicate and deliver our culture internally. We have been awarded as a NorthCoast 99 “Best Workplace” winner for 14 consecutive years in recognition of our employee commitment. Park Place Life is about collaboration, responsiveness, diversity, and integrity, and represents everything that makes our company great and our culture unique.


Technical Support Engineer Level 3 – Wintel/VMWare


The Technical Support Engineer L3 is responsible for proactively responding to the technical challenges and requirements for customers within the Managed Services environments. The Managed Services department is primarily focused on delivering the whole solutions lifecycle, including; Presales, design, implementing, supporting, maintaining and decommissioning data centre solutions to ensure the continuity of business operations for all customers. This role is expected to work with other members of the managed services and technical teams in implementing and supporting solutions for new and existing customers.


What you’ll be doing:

· Deliver support solutions for Managed Services customers in line with industry best practice to deliver continual service improvement over the whole service lifecycle.

· Work closely with WINTEL Team Lead to ensure new customers are migrated with seamless handover / transition from onboarding into the steady state managed service environment.

· Implementing new and refreshed managed service solutions for hosted customer environments.

· Dynamically monitor, manage and improve managed service environments. Identifying and resolving root cause of issues and ensuring continual service availability.

· Strive for continual service improvement based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.

· Contribute proactively to new service development.

· Deliver a high-performance culture in the team with a focus on teamwork, service excellence and ownership for resolving customer issues.

· Guarantee operational procedures and practices are well defined, documented and consistently applied.

· Ensure quality, up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.

· Other duties assigned


What we’re looking for:

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a 3rd line support or administration role, predominantly

working within data centre services and infrastructure.

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience with virtualization technologies i.e. VMware or Hyper-V

· Minimum of 7 years’ experience with Server operating systems; Windows Server, Linux or Unix.

· Detailed technical understanding of other datacenter technologies including storage, backup, disaster recovery and security.

· Storage connectivity experience within vCenter for troubleshooting

· OEM knowledge-based competencies, preferred.

· Ability to understand and navigate technical situations with strong problem-solving and remedy skills.

· Experience in technical project management.

· Experience in producing low-level technical designs and supporting implementation documentation.

· Experience in performing technical presentations and customer workshops.

· Fluent in English


Bonus Points:

· Vendor certifications a plus (current VCP, MCS Server Virtualization with Windows Server Hyper-V and System Center) – may be required for specific platform support needs.

· Project Management Certification (Prince2 or equivalent)


Education:

· Bachelor’s degree required.


Travel:

· 5-10%


If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by

calling .


Park Place Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V.


Park Place Technologies has an in-house recruiting team that focuses exclusively on the hiring needs of our company. We are not currently accepting additional third-party agreements or unsolicited resumes. If you would like to be considered as a preferred partner with Park Place

Technologies, please submit your detailed information to Any CVs submitted directly to hiring managers will be considered unsolicited and become the property of Park Place Technologies

Park Place Technologies is a global data center and networking optimization firm. Powered by the world’s largest on-the-ground engineering team, a robust group of advanced engineers and our fully staffed, 24x7x365 Enterprise Operations Center, we offer a robust portfolio of IT solutions to optimize networking and data center Uptime and performance. As the industry leader, our 2500 Park Place Associates provide support to 21,000+ customers in more than 180+ countries. We are proud to service 90% of Fortune 500 companies and 40% of Forbes 100 clients. Our company’s strength and success are a credit to our Associates, and Park Place Life is how we communicate and deliver our culture internally. We have been awarded as a NorthCoast 99 “Best Workplace” winner for 14 consecutive years in recognition of our employee commitment. Park Place Life is about collaboration, responsiveness, diversity, and integrity, and represents everything that makes our company great and our culture unique.


Technical Support Engineer Level 3 – Wintel/VMWare


The Technical Support Engineer L3 is responsible for proactively responding to the technical challenges and requirements for customers within the Managed Services environments. The Managed Services department is primarily focused on delivering the whole solutions lifecycle, including; Presales, design, implementing, supporting, maintaining and decommissioning data centre solutions to ensure the continuity of business operations for all customers. This role is expected to work with other members of the managed services and technical teams in implementing and supporting solutions for new and existing customers.


What you’ll be doing:

· Deliver support solutions for Managed Services customers in line with industry best practice to deliver continual service improvement over the whole service lifecycle.

· Work closely with WINTEL Team Lead to ensure new customers are migrated with seamless handover / transition from onboarding into the steady state managed service environment.

· Implementing new and refreshed managed service solutions for hosted customer environments.

· Dynamically monitor, manage and improve managed service environments. Identifying and resolving root cause of issues and ensuring continual service availability.

· Strive for continual service improvement based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.

· Contribute proactively to new service development.

· Deliver a high-performance culture in the team with a focus on teamwork, service excellence and ownership for resolving customer issues.

· Guarantee operational procedures and practices are well defined, documented and consistently applied.

· Ensure quality, up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.

· Other duties assigned


What we’re looking for:

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a 3rd line support or administration role, predominantly

working within data centre services and infrastructure.

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience with virtualization technologies i.e. VMware or Hyper-V

· Minimum of 7 years’ experience with Server operating systems; Windows Server, Linux or Unix.

· Detailed technical understanding of other datacenter technologies including storage, backup, disaster recovery and security.

· Storage connectivity experience within vCenter for troubleshooting

· OEM knowledge-based competencies, preferred.

· Ability to understand and navigate technical situations with strong problem-solving and remedy skills.

· Experience in technical project management.

· Experience in producing low-level technical designs and supporting implementation documentation.

· Experience in performing technical presentations and customer workshops.

· Fluent in English


Bonus Points:

· Vendor certifications a plus (current VCP, MCS Server Virtualization with Windows Server Hyper-V and System Center) – may be required for specific platform support needs.

· Project Management Certification (Prince2 or equivalent)


Education:

· Bachelor’s degree required.


Travel:

· 5-10%


If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by

calling .


Park Place Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V.


Park Place Technologies has an in-house recruiting team that focuses exclusively on the hiring needs of our company. We are not currently accepting additional third-party agreements or unsolicited resumes. If you would like to be considered as a preferred partner with Park Place

Technologies, please submit your detailed information to Any CVs submitted directly to hiring managers will be considered unsolicited and become the property of Park Place Technologies

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Vaga | Senior Data Engineer / BI Engineer – Microsoft Stack (SSRS Mandatório)


Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Data Engineer / BI Engineer para atuar na engenharia, modelagem e disponibilização de dados corporativos, com forte foco em Microsoft SQL Server e SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).


Essa é uma posição estratégica, voltada para ambientes corporativos críticos, responsável por relatórios oficiais, operacionais e gerenciais, com atuação próxima a times de backend e áreas de negócio.


Inglês fluente é mandatório.


Responsabilidades


Projetar, desenvolver e manter modelos de dados relacionais e dimensionais (Data Warehouse / Data Marts).


Desenvolver, otimizar e manter stored procedures, views, funções e queries complexas em SQL Server (T-SQL).


Atuar fortemente em performance tuning (índices, execution plans, concorrência).


Desenvolver e manter relatórios corporativos em SSRS, incluindo:


Relatórios paginados


Sub-relatórios


Parâmetros dinâmicos


Expressions e formatações avançadas


Construir e manter pipelines de dados (ETL) para carga, transformação e consolidação.


Garantir qualidade, consistência, integridade e governança dos dados.


Atuar em parceria com times de backend, entendendo integrações, APIs e fluxos de dados.


Apoiar áreas de negócio na definição de métricas, indicadores e modelos de informação.


Documentar modelos, relatórios e fluxos de dados.


✅ Requisitos Obrigatórios


SQL Server & Data Modeling


Experiência sólida com Microsoft SQL Server.


Domínio de T-SQL avançado.


Forte experiência em modelagem de dados:


Modelagem relacional


Modelagem dimensional (Star Schema / Snowflake)


Fatos, dimensões e histórico (SCD)


SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)


Experiência obrigatória e comprovada com SSRS.


Criação e manutenção de:


Relatórios paginados


Sub-relatórios


Parâmetros e filtros complexos


Expressions avançadas


Conhecimento em performance, segurança e deploy de relatórios SSRS.


ETL & Integrações


Experiência com ETL / pipelines de dados (preferencialmente SSIS ou equivalente).


Vivência com cargas incrementais, reprocessamentos e tratamento de falhas.


Backend Microsoft


Experiência com tecnologias Microsoft, como:


NET / C# (leitura, manutenção ou desenvolvimento básico)


Integrações de aplicações com SQL Server


Jobs, serviços e processos batch


Capacidade de atuar integrado a times de backend.


Experiência


Perfil Sênior.


Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e estruturados.


Inglês fluente.


Diferenciais


Experiência com Azure (Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, App Services).


Conhecimento em Power BI como camada de consumo.


Vivência em Shared Services ou grandes estruturas corporativas.


Experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, indústria, saúde, logística).


Como se candidatar

Envie seu CV para


Assunto do e-mail: Engenheiro de Dados

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Busca & Recomendação
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Staff Software Engineer para atuar como referência técnica no time de busca e recomendação , contexto esse de alta criticidade. Sendo responsável por construir e evoluir soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alto desempenho .

Essa posição tem papel estratégico na evolução arquitetural , na tomada de decisões tecnológicas , na elevação contínua da qualidade técnica e na condução de iniciativas de alto impacto para o negócio .


O que você vai fazer

  • Atuar como referência técnica do time , guiando decisões arquiteturais e garantindo excelência em engenharia;
  • Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir sistemas de larga escala utilizando Go (Golang) e .NET;
  • Arquitetar e implementar soluções em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , com foco em automação, escalabilidade, segurança e confiabilidade;
  • Trabalhar com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais , garantindo performance e consistência;
  • Implementar e evoluir práticas de observabilidade , utilizando Datadog, Grafana e ferramentas correlatas;
  • Liderar iniciativas de CI/CD , qualidade de código e engenharia de confiabilidade (SRE);
  • Mentorar engenheiros, promovendo boas práticas, padrões técnicos e crescimento do time .


O que você precisa para a posição no jogo:

  • Experiência com ElasticSearch , incluindo tuning e otimização de motores de busca para e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning aplicado a relevância e ranking , do motor de busca;
  • Domínio em .NET e/ou Golang;
  • Forte experiência com GCP e infraestrutura em cloud;
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de produtores e consumidores de eventos para Event Streaming (Kafka);
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Kubernetes , incluindo deploy, escalabilidade e operação de aplicações conteinerizadas;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Vivência com observabilidade (Datadog, Grafana, Kibana);
  • Experiência com CI/CD e práticas modernas de engenharia de software;
  • Noções ou experiência em Ciência de Dados;
  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de busca em e-commerce;
  • Vivência com experimentação , métricas e testes A/B para validação de hipóteses e comprovação de conceitos.


O que esperamos do seu perfil

  • Mentalidade de dono , com visão sistêmica e foco em longo prazo;
  • Capacidade de influenciar tecnicamente e elevar a barra do time;
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e assertiva , inclusive com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Perfil colaborativo , pragmático e orientado a resultados.

title: Android Developer (Realocation to Portugal)
description:
Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in Android development;
  • Hands-on experience with Coroutines or RxJava;
  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and well-structured code;
  • Experience working in collaborative development environments;
  • English level B2 or higher, with the ability to communicate effectively;
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese;
  • Willingness to relocate from Brazil to Portugal;
  • Available to work in Porto or Lisbon (hybrid work model).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to:

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

title: Application Developer (Maintenance - JAVA/MySQL)
description:
We are looking for an Application Developer with strong experience in Java and My to support and enhance our client's application system, on the transportation product line.

The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

  • Portal & Server Management: Troubleshoot portal server ers, monitor AWS logs, and ensure report delivery.
  • ETL & Data Operations: Manage ETL file uploads, monitor ongoing/completed loads, and resolve missing data issues.
  • Reporting (JasperReports): Maintain and enhance custom reports, add/remove columns and filters, manage run tickets, and troubleshoot disappearing reports.
  • Database Management (My): Perform schema updates, optimize queries, and ensure data integrity for reporting and ETL processes.
  • Integrations: Support Samsara, Geotab, and Motive integrations and data imports.
  • Environment Management: Handle migrations between Alpha, Beta, and Production environments.
  • Bulk Updates: Execute mass-scale changes (Tank ID, Lease Name, Account, Terminal details) and perform data cleanup.


Required Experience

  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience using Java and My
  • Solid understanding of AWS logs and backend troubleshooting, preferably using Cloud watch
  • Comfortable working in CI/CD environments with Agile development practices
  • Understanding of ETL & Data Management for file uploads and load monitoring
  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a proactive mindset
  • Able to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with JasperReports
  • Prior experience using React.js


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Technical Support Engineer - Level 3 (VMWare)
description:
About the Company

Park Place Technologies is a global data center and networking optimization firm. Powered by the world’s largest on-the-ground engineering team, a robust group of advanced engineers and our fully staffed, 24x7x365 Enterprise Operations Center, we offer a robust portfolio of IT solutions to optimize networking and data center Uptime and performance. As the industry leader, our 2500 Park Place Associates provide support to 21,000+ customers in more than 180+ countries. We are proud to service 90% of Fortune 500 companies and 40% of Forbes 100 clients. Our company’s strength and success are a credit to our Associates, and Park Place Life is how we communicate and deliver our culture internally. We have been awarded as a NorthCoast 99 “Best Workplace” winner for 14 consecutive years in recognition of our employee commitment. Park Place Life is about collaboration, responsiveness, diversity, and integrity, and represents everything that makes our company great and our culture unique.


Technical Support Engineer Level 3 – Wintel/VMWare


The Technical Support Engineer L3 is responsible for proactively responding to the technical challenges and requirements for customers within the Managed Services environments. The Managed Services department is primarily focused on delivering the whole solutions lifecycle, including; Presales, design, implementing, supporting, maintaining and decommissioning data centre solutions to ensure the continuity of business operations for all customers. This role is expected to work with other members of the managed services and technical teams in implementing and supporting solutions for new and existing customers.


What you’ll be doing:

· Deliver support solutions for Managed Services customers in line with industry best practice to deliver continual service improvement over the whole service lifecycle.

· Work closely with WINTEL Team Lead to ensure new customers are migrated with seamless handover / transition from onboarding into the steady state managed service environment.

· Implementing new and refreshed managed service solutions for hosted customer environments.

· Dynamically monitor, manage and improve managed service environments. Identifying and resolving root cause of issues and ensuring continual service availability.

· Strive for continual service improvement based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.

· Contribute proactively to new service development.

· Deliver a high-performance culture in the team with a focus on teamwork, service excellence and ownership for resolving customer issues.

· Guarantee operational procedures and practices are well defined, documented and consistently applied.

· Ensure quality, up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.

· Other duties assigned


What we’re looking for:

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a 3rd line support or administration role, predominantly

working within data centre services and infrastructure.

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience with virtualization technologies i.e. VMware or Hyper-V

· Minimum of 7 years’ experience with Server operating systems; Windows Server, Linux or Unix.

· Detailed technical understanding of other datacenter technologies including storage, backup, disaster recovery and security.

· Storage connectivity experience within vCenter for troubleshooting

· OEM knowledge-based competencies, preferred.

· Ability to understand and navigate technical situations with strong problem-solving and remedy skills.

· Experience in technical project management.

· Experience in producing low-level technical designs and supporting implementation documentation.

· Experience in performing technical presentations and customer workshops.

· Fluent in English


Bonus Points:

· Vendor certifications a plus (current VCP, MCS Server Virtualization with Windows Server Hyper-V and System Center) – may be required for specific platform support needs.

· Project Management Certification (Prince2 or equivalent)


Education:

· Bachelor’s degree required.


Travel:

· 5-10%


If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by

calling .

title: ANALISTA DE GESTÃO FINANCEIRA DE PROJETOS SÊNIOR
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Responsável pelo acompanhamento financeiro e apoio no orçamento anual dos novos shoppings, expansões, projetos VGVs, e torres. Elaboração dos relatórios das performances de projeto;

Acompanhamento das change orders dos projetos (novos shoppings e expansão), acompanhamento dos projetos - obra e a comercialização de espaços, CAPEX e Receitas, apoio para a reunião de performance dos novos projetos, apoio na preparação dos relatórios para os Comitês, apoio no SAP: relatórios para a Performance de Projetos, apoio no Orçamento de DGI e projetos.


RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

  • Analisar e acompanhar CAPEX;
  • Projeção dos valores atualizados mensalmente pelas áreas na planilha CAPEX para projeção do Cash da empresa;
  • Monitorar performance dos projetos;
  • Controlar aspectos financeiros dos projetos;
  • Avaliar viabilidade e calcular taxa interna de retorno (TIR);
  • Conhecimento em Project Finance;
  • Atuar em alinhamento com áreas de planejamento estratégico e integrado;
  • Acompanhamento dos projetos e preparação da pauta das RE's de performance de projetos, obras relevantes e pequenas reformas;
  • Interface com área de Controladoria;
  • Reportar performance ao Gerente PMO;
  • Elaborar apresentações (PPT) para o CEO.


OBSERVAÇÕES

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia, ou Economia;
  • Experiência com SAP e integração de sistemas;
  • Excel avançado (acompanhamento de pagamentos, análises, relatórios);
  • Conhecimento em gestão de projetos;
  • Experiência prévia em empresas de projetos imobiliários (diferencial, não obrigatório);
  • Capacidade analítica e foco em resultados;
  • Forte habilidade de relacionamento para interação com diversas áreas;
  • Boa comunicação e dicção clara para apresentações e alinhamentos.

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Wordpress Plugin & Full Stack Developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.


Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?


Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.


Responsibilities

  • Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
  • Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
  • Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
  • Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
  • Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
  • Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
  • Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
  • Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
  • Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
  • On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
  • Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
  • Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
  • Test Planning and Execution:  Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality. 
  • Defect Management:  Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
  • Collaboration:  Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality. 
  • Automation:  Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks. 
  • Quality Standards:  Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. 


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
  • This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • If selected, you'll receive invite to a couple skills test before video interview


Requirements Before Employment

  • Signed Confidentiality agreement
  • Signed Non-compete agreement
  • Signed Contract & W-8 BEN tax form


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
  • We're very loyal, focused, dedicated and hard-working.
  • Hours 8AM - 5PM, Mon-Fri, with certain US holidays included

title: SAP Coupa  Source to Pay
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Coupa - Source to Pay who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


\"Responsibilities for this role include:

Developer with knowledge Solutions Design for Coupa, Configuration, Documentation, Testing, and Delivery with intelligent automation (Scope includes work among SAP and non-SAP Systems and Applications)

Excellent technical & functional configuration knowledge and demonstrated proficiency for SAP Source to Pay, inclusive of Smart Contract Management, Spend Analytics, Guided Buying, and Collaborative Supply Chain & Procurement Materials Management, Materials Management (Direct and Indirect)

Participate in gathering and documenting overall business requirements. Support all formal documentation of implementation and provide relevant functional inputs to technical team.

Configure and implement Coupa solutions for source to pay processes. Should be able to perform global Coupa configuration, Approval Workflow, Custom field set up for transactions, Chart of account, PO forms, Catalog, Supplier, Item, User setup, Security Roles and Permission as per business requirement.

Experience in Coupa Configuration and data loads in Sourcing, Contracting, Purchasing, invoicing Master data(Supplier, Materials and Accounting data) and Catalog Management.

Experience with Coupa integration and mapping to legacy SAP systems for transactional and master data interface in source to pay.

Create functional specification documents that require development of WRICEF (Workflow Reports Interfaces Conversion Enhancement and Form) objects

Prepare test cases, validate deliverables, and support client testing and user acceptance testing (UAT).

Responsible for solving complex business problems by creating IT solutions in consultation with business partners, architects and other stakeholders\"


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Health insurance

Life insurance

Childcare assistance

International experience opportunity

title: Desenvolvedor de .NET sênior
description:
Estamos contratando DESENVOLVEDOR FULL STACK .NET PLENO


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolver e manter sistemas utilizando a linguagem de programação C# e os frameworks .NET Framework ou .NET Core;
  • Análise, correção de incidentes e atendimento de melhorias relacionados a sistemas em produção;
  • Criar e otimizar consultas SQL no Postegresql para interagir com o banco de dados;
  • Colaborar com a equipe para entender e analisar requisitos de software;
  • Codificar, testar e depurar aplicativos de software;
  • Implementar melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software e seguir os padrões de codificação estabelecidos;
  • Resolver problemas e bugs de forma eficiente e eficaz;
  • Realizar a documentação dos artefatos de desenvolvimento de sistemas;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe e outras áreas quando necessário;
  • Apoiar na implementação de interfaces de usuário utilizando React.


O QUE PRECISA TER:

  • Superior completo nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação, Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência em programação C# usando .NET Framework ou .NET Core;
  • Experiência em Banco de Dados;
  • Experiência em React.


Conhecimentos em:

  • Lógica de programação;
  • Programação Orientada a Objetos;
  • Programação C#, ASP.NET, .Net Core, SQL;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados SQL e Postgre;
  • Web Services (SOAP, REST);
  • Conhecimento dos fundamentos de HTTP;
  • Inglês Técnico;
  • Fundamentos de desenvolvimento frontend (HTML, CSS e JavaScript);
  • Noções de integração entre frontend e backend (consumo de APIs REST);
  • Conhecimento em React;
  • Controle de versão com Git.

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Analista de Desenvolvimento de Software Pleno
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Atuar como analista de desenvolvimento em uma das Squads dos produtos TOTVS RH (linha RM), assegurando a qualidade das entregas do time a fim de que os requisitos de software

solicitados pelo PO sejam atendidos.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Desenvolvimento, testes e documentação de features de inovação, legislação e manutenção nos produtos TOTVS RH, utilizando tecnologias c#.Net, ASP.NET e Angular em arquitetura N camadas.
  • Aplicar inovações incrementais nos sistemas legados.
  • Trabalhar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções de RH, com intuito de melhorar a experiência de nossos produtos para nossos clientes;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com a Squad conforme os processos ágeis definidos pela empresa, com objetivo de atingir as metas do time;
  • Garantir que as entregas estão em conformidade com as boas práticas e convenções internas;
  • Desenvolver Testes Unitários, Testes Automatizados e Documentar funcionalidades desenvolvidas.
  • Orientar e trabalhar com o time de desenvolvimento para encontrar soluções de negócio, arquitetura e desenho através da comunicação e trocas de conhecimento;
  • Manter a qualidade do software verificando os processos, ferramentas e boas práticas disponíveis para o produto e tecnologia utilizados;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade apoiando suas dúvidas, disseminando seu conhecimento, desenhando e arquitetando soluções ou indicando documentação de apoio;


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Formação superior em andamento/completa área de tecnologia e afins;
  • Experiência com a linguagem de programação C#;
  • Boa lógica de programação e POO;
  • Conhecimento em HTML/CSS;
  • Conhecimento em JavaScript/TypeScript;
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados;
  • Processo Ágil;
  • Boas práticas de programação, princípios SOLID;
  • Desejável Experiência nos produtos TOTVS RM.
  • Banco de Dados – nível intermediário;


INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

Dito isso, oferecemos:

● Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada colaborador;

● Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada colaborador com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;

● Programa +Vantagens, a maior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para colaboradores;

● Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para colaboradores e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria...

● Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

● Plano de saúde e odontológico;

● Vale refeição e / ou alimentação;

● Vale transporte;

● Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

● Espaço de lactário;

● Bicicletário;

● Vestiário;

● Seguro de vida;

● Auxílio creche;

● Previdência privada;

● Escritório que estimula a criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

● Gympass.

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e inclusão, consideramos todos os candidatos para as nossas vagas, independente de cor, raça, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascendência, idade, etc.

title: Wordpress Plugin & Full Stack Developer
description:
Please only apply if you are familiar with Wordpress Plugin Development, with strong PHP skills in additional to being a full stack (front and back) developer. Ideally you should also be comfortable with mobile apps and figuring out and doing different things in tech and thrive in a fast-paced fluid environment.


Do you love technology puzzles and figuring out how to make a variety of things to work? Are you great at catching mistakes through user testing for quality assurance? Are you a dedicated, resourceful team player with strong problem solving skills? Do you have experience working with numerous different technology platforms in digital form, ranging from CRMs (like Constant Contact, Aweber, Beehiiv), Hosting (AWS, WHM), DNS (Cloudflare), Automtions (like zapier, make.com), project management (like jira.com)?


Detail oriented test and php / elementor test REQUIRED before video interview.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies in the United States stock market and other large scale projects. We started in 2019. We internally own 10 newsletter brands, a mobile app, and other digital assets.


Responsibilities

  • Focus on building out custom wordpress plugins for internal agency needs
  • Focus on connecting marketing data for purposes of analysis, can range from open rates in crm, to costs on paid media platforms, to click through data on sms provider.
  • Setting up CRM lists, automations, and funnels from start to finish with script, reporting and directly on the platforms.
  • Willing to have a flexible set of responsibilities to service whatever is required in daily operations, including posting daily new article first thing in the mornings.
  • Work hand-in-hand with CTO and CMO on various directives. If you see a way to do it better, we'd love to hear it.
  • Handle multiple projects from start to finish, adhering to set deadlines set by CTO or CMO.
  • Doing or setting up manual/automated reporting related to adspend, subscriber counts, open rates, cost per lead, etc
  • Copying, testing, and fixing Elementor landing pages and ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS, webhooks, etc.
  • Copying, testing, fixing PHP scripts ensuring they are properly connected to CRM, SMS provider, webhooks, postbacks, etc.
  • On CRM set up lists/segments, automations for the welcome emails, templates, list cleaning,
  • Doing specific weekly and monthly audits of our 10 newsletter landing page and script funnels.
  • Testing and helping manage our mobile app.
  • Test Planning and Execution:  Design and implement test plans, scenarios, and procedures to test software functionality. 
  • Defect Management:  Identify, document, and track software defects (that you can't fix), then work with developers to ensure they are corrected before release
  • Collaboration:  Communicate and collaborate with developers, product managers, and other team members to understand requirements and provide feedback on usability and functionality. 
  • Automation:  Code and implement automated test scripts using various tools and frameworks. 
  • Quality Standards:  Create and enforce guidelines for software quality standards within the company. 


Qualifications

  • Proficient in Wordpress, Elementor, PHP, HTML/CSS
  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, problem solving skills
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have the ability to multitask, in a VERY fast paced work environment.
  • This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • If selected, you'll receive invite to a couple skills test before video interview


Requirements Before Employment

  • Signed Confidentiality agreement
  • Signed Non-compete agreement
  • Signed Contract & W-8 BEN tax form


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.
  • We're very loyal, focused, dedicated and hard-working.
  • Hours 8AM - 5PM, Mon-Fri, with certain US holidays included

title: Revenue Operations Associate
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About SpendHound:

  • SpendHound is a 100% free software renewal management platform and service recently launched by the research firm YipitData. (See this introductory video from SpendHound’s Senior Product Manager!)
  • SpendHound is the single source of truth for companies’ renewal information and includes:
  • A comprehensive view of all software applications used with annual contract values, auto-renewal information, renewal dates, license counts, and more
  • An invoice and contract management system for companies to store their invoices and contracts
  • Renewal reminders through email and Slack so companies never miss upcoming software renewals
  • Free advice from procurement experts to discuss price benchmarking insights and negotiation strategies for any upcoming renewals
  • Companies use the SpendHound platform and procurement expert service to save time and money on their software renewals.
  • SpendHound is free for customers because customer data is de-identified, aggregated with other panelists, and used as part of YipitData market research (example report ).


About The Role:

Are you a collaborative consulting, analytics, or operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team?

We are seeking a Revenue Operations Associate to play a crucial role in our fast-growing team, SpendHound. As a fast-growing “start-up” within a larger organization, this is a unique opportunity for someone with a strong operational mindset to come in and help build something truly special.


We expect East work hours.


As our Revenue Operations Associate, you will partner with our Sales and Marketing teams to:

  • Be an operations subject matter expert for the Sales function, working closely with RevOps and Spendhound leadership to support Sales and execute on key initiatives
  • Implement processes and solutions that can streamline revenue acquisition and eliminate inefficiencies
  • Maintain and measure various components of the Sales process, such as
  • Target/Territory Management
  • Lead Generation, and
  • Outbound Cadence Operations.
  • Ensure that the Sales teams are operating seamlessly through data evaluation and by improving workflows


You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • Operations professional with 3+ years of experience, passionate about building a world-class revenue team.
  • You demonstrate a high aptitude for organization, process development, project and change management, and analytics
  • You have advanced Excel skills
  • Your experience with CRMs such as Salesforce.com
  • You are willing to become proficient in SQL and data management
  • You are a natural problem-solver, with a keen eye for detail and spotting issues
